title: All triples that sum to zero
summary: Find every distinct trio of friends whose glow values add up to zero, by fixing one and squeezing the other two from both ends.
goal: List every distinct trio whose values add up to zero

examples.label: Six friends
examples.explanation: Two distinct trios add up to zero.

examples.label: Three zeros
examples.explanation: One trio, even though the values repeat.

ladder.name: Try every trio
ladder.idea: Check every combination of three positions and collect the trios that sum to zero, removing repeats.

ladder.name: Fix one, look up the third
ladder.idea: Fix the first friend, then for each second friend look up whether the needed third glow was seen.
ladder.insight: Once two glows are chosen, the third is determined: it must be minus their sum. A set finds it without a third loop.

ladder.name: Sort, fix one, squeeze two
ladder.idea: Sort the glows. Fix one friend and find pairs to its right with two pointers from the ends, skipping equal values to avoid repeated trios.
ladder.insight: After sorting, the remaining pair search is the sorted pair problem from the gift-voucher lesson, and equal values sit side by side, so repeats are easy to skip.

transfer.problem: Find all distinct trios of weights from a box that together weigh exactly 1,000 grams.
transfer.explanation: Sort the weights, fix one, and look for a pair adding up to the rest with two pointers, skipping equal weights.

selfCheck: Sorts first, so pairs can be found with two pointers.
Skips equal values for the fixed friend and for both pointers after a match.
